undertale_death_screen.config.shard_rend:
Configures the style of the shattered heart pieces.
  Animated: The piece will animate but not rotate.
  Rotated: The piece will rotate but will not be animated.
undertale_death_screen.config.music_turn: Whether to stop all sound & music whenever you die
undertale_death_screen.config.centered_h: Whether to center the heart in the middle.

Whether to smoothly animate the heart to the center of the
screen before shattering.
Speed of the heart center animation.
undertale_death_screen.config.determinat: Whether to play music (by default Determination from Undertale) on the death screen.
undertale_death_screen.config.dynamicHea:
Whether to dynamically change the heart texture and color based on the player status. Supported is:
 - Being poisoned
 - Withering away
 - Freezing
undertale_death_screen.config.background:
The speed at which to fill the screen with black.
If set to 0, it is disabled.
If set to 1, it is instantaneous
undertale_death_screen.config.vanilla_fa: Whether the normal death screen fades in smoothly after shattering.
How long the fade takes in ticks (20 = 1 second).
undertale_death_screen.config.text_fade_: Whether the 'You died' text fades in smoothly after the heart shatters.
How long the text fade in takes in ticks (20 = 1 second).
undertale_death_screen.config.fade_to_va: Whether the black background slowly fades to the vanilla death screen background.
Speed of fading back to the vanilla screen.
undertale_death_screen.config.fixed_anim: If true, the animation runs at a stable 60 FPS regardless of your framerate.
undertale_death_screen.config.disable_bu: If true, you cannot click Respawn/Title Screen before the animation finishes.
undertale_death_screen.config.disable_va: Disables the vanilla red tint around the edges of the screen after death animation.
config.independent_bgm_volume.ttp: If enabled, the death screen music will ignore the Music volume setting and only depend on the Master volume.
